name: com.crosbynews/weather
title: Crosby, TX Weather
description: Crosby, TX weather, air, tropics, floods, fishing, pollen, roads, burn bans, radar, news & schools.

tools.name: get_current_conditions
tools.description: Current weather for Crosby, TX from the National Weather Service. The `current` block is the NWS hourly forecast period in effect at current.startTime: temperature (°F), sky, probabilityOfPrecipitation, feelsLike, dewpointF, humidityPercent, and wind speed as text in mph. Those are forecast values, not a station observation. `updated` is when this data was refreshed. Also the EPA UV index, a summary of measured air quality (for AQI detail use get_air_quality), and sunrise/sunset. For an AQI-only question, use get_air_quality.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: NWS forecast for Crosby, TX: the 7-day day/night forecast (temperatures °F, wind in mph), or upcoming hourly periods if `hours` is given (1–48, about two days out). For hazards already in effect, use get_alerts first; for flooding, get_river_levels; for Atlantic systems, get_tropical_outlook.

hours.description: Return this many upcoming hourly periods instead of the daily forecast.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Active NWS weather alerts for Crosby, TX, each with event, headline, severity and expiry. Call this first for anything happening now. Returns an empty list when none are active. For later periods use get_forecast; for river flooding, get_river_levels; for roads, get_traffic.

tools.name: get_tropical_outlook
tools.description: Atlantic-basin tropical activity from the NOAA National Hurricane Center: named storms, and the unnamed areas NHC is watching for development, with formation chances. Not specific to Crosby, TX. Refreshed about hourly June–November and about daily the rest of the year. Returns an explicit all-clear only when both lists are empty; an empty `storms` list alone does not mean a quiet basin.

tools.name: get_pollen
tools.description: The Houston Health Department's measured daily pollen and mold count (National Allergy Bureau scale) — tree, weed, and grass pollen plus mold spores, with the species actually counted. A real measurement, not a model; counts publish weekday mornings and apply regionally to Crosby, TX.

tools.name: get_burn_ban
tools.description: Current outdoor-burning ban status for Harris County, TX (which includes Crosby) from the Texas A&M Forest Service, with a lift the Harris County Fire Marshal's Office has announced before the map shows it. Countywide only — TFS has no sub-county resolution, so this is never a Crosby-specific status.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.description: Current U.S. Air Quality Index (0–500). When measured:true it is the EPA/AirNow monitor reading for the Houston-Galveston-Brazoria reporting area, which includes Crosby, TX: a regional reading, not Crosby-specific. When measured:false it is an Open-Meteo modeled estimate at Crosby's coordinates, not a monitor reading. Use this for AQI questions; get_current_conditions also carries an AQI summary.

tools.name: get_crosby_news
tools.description: Recent local news headlines for Crosby, TX and nearby northeast Harris County communities, aggregated from public sources and filtered for relevance. Empty when nothing recent.

tools.name: get_school_events
tools.description: Upcoming Crosby ISD school-calendar events: first/last day of school, holidays, no-school and early-release days, testing windows, and campus activities.

tools.name: get_river_levels
tools.description: Current water levels at the NWS gauges near Crosby, TX (Cedar Bayou, San Jacinto River, Luce Bayou, Goose Creek, East Fork San Jacinto). Each gauge reports stage in feet, flow in cfs (often null), its NWS flood category (no_flooding, action, minor, moderate, major, or not_defined), and flood-stage thresholds in feet. Gauges come in a fixed order, not by severity, each with its own validTime. For flooding now use this; for past crests use get_flood_history; for fishing-water conditions use get_fishing.

tools.name: get_fishing
tools.description: Live USGS water conditions for the waters people fish near Crosby, TX (Lake Houston, the San Jacinto River forks, the Trinity River, and nearby bayous): water temperature in °F, dissolved oxygen in mg/L, pH, and turbidity in FNU. Some fished bayous report gage height in feet only. A nearby-station reading, not the exact fishing spot, and conditions rather than a guaranteed bite. For flood stages, use get_river_levels.

tools.name: get_traffic
tools.description: Live traffic incidents and scheduled lane closures on the roads Crosby, TX drives — US-90, FM-2100, FM-1942, and the Crosby stretch of IH-10 East — from Houston TranStar, plus links to the corridor traffic cameras. High-water road reports appear here during floods. Empty lists mean quiet roads.

tools.name: get_emergency_contacts
tools.description: Emergency resource directory for Crosby, TX (unincorporated Harris County): 911 guidance, sheriff non-emergency, power-outage and gas-leak reporting, the CAER industrial-incident line, flood and road tools, shelters, and disaster assistance. Static verified directory — in a life-threatening emergency, call 911.

tools.name: get_radar
tools.description: Latest NWS KHGX (Houston/Galveston) radar still image covering Crosby, TX, returned inline as a GIF. For the animated loop, see https://crosbynews.com/radar.

tools.name: get_flood_history
tools.description: The flood record for the river gauges near Crosby, TX that have one (Cedar Bayou near Crosby, the San Jacinto River near Sheldon and at Lake Houston, the East Fork San Jacinto near New Caney): each gauge's highest historic crests as NOAA publishes them, measured against TODAY's NWS flood stages (stages may have differed when a crest happened), how many crests and river flood warnings the record holds, and a link to the full page. Crests NOAA marks as on an older gauge datum are counted but never compared. For current levels use get_river_levels.

tools.name: get_warning_history
tools.description: How many National Weather Service warnings, watches and advisories have covered Crosby, TX, by type and year, computed from the site's record: tornado, severe thunderstorm, flash flood and flood warnings whose polygon contained Crosby (counted from 2007-10-01, when polygons became the official warned area), products for forecast zone TXZ213 (tropical, winter, heat, fire weather, fog; the zone has been redrawn), and Harris County watches. Includes the date of every tornado warning. For active alerts use get_alerts.

tools.name: get_rainfall
tools.description: Rain measured by the USGS weather station at the Lake Houston dam, about 5 miles west of Crosby, TX, in 15-minute amounts: the last hour, the last 24 hours, the day so far, and the last 7 days. Each window ends at the latest reading (latestReading), not at the current time, so check latestReading before reading a window as recent. A window or day short of its readings is marked incomplete and its total may be low; a missing reading is not a dry spell. Amounts are inches. Readings are provisional USGS data. This is one station, and rain can differ a lot over a few miles. For the forecast use get_forecast; for flooding use get_river_levels.
